Planning used five perspectives and cross-examination. Back reachability, resolved state and focus became separate checks.
Three finders and a fresh verifier reproduced four distinct coordination defects. Original medium-severity findings and separate post-fix verification are retained.
The Labs case exchanged assignment, ACK, delivery and review messages. The PM accepted the three-method delivery once. Work was already in progress; turns are manual.
Actual public Labs browser recording at its original speed. Follow the real entry into the first question; no answers are entered.
Help is operated with sequential keyboard focus, Enter and Space. Reopening and closing are checked separately.
Close restores focus to the summary. Sequential Tab then reaches Back.
Enter returns to the introduction. Heading focus, visible Start and the unanswered state have separate evidence.
Desktop English entry/state scope only. No general performance or accessibility claim. Read the reports, provenance and limits. Publication and application remain separate.
